children: The dollar index rose to 99 on Thursday, as another rally in oil prices amid escalating hostilities between the US and Iran prompted investors to increase bets on a Fed rate hike next week.
Markets are now pricing a 70% chance of a 25bps increase, up from 60% yesterday, while a hike is fully priced in for October.
The PPI report did little to alter expectations.
While headline producer inflation accelerated to 0.4%, core PPI rose 0.2% mom, below both the previous month’s 0.3% increase and forecasts of 0.3%.
The CPI report on Friday will be key in assessing the outlook for price pressures.
Elsewhere, the ECB raised borrowing costs by 25bps as expected and lifted its inflation forecasts.

title: USD Appreciates on Thursday
